Each takes 7 Bolt of Runecloth, 2 Ironweb Spider Silk, 4 Rugged Leather and 1 Rune Thread. Make the 434 Bolt of Runecloth first. Its pattern (Pattern: Runecloth Shoulders) drops from mobs all over the world and does not bind: buy it at the Auction House. Seven bolts, two Ironweb Spider Silk and four Rugged Leather a craft: the dearest stretch. The spiders of Western Plaguelands and Silithus drop the silk (the marked spots), or the Auction House. No pattern on the Auction House? Runecloth Gloves still give a point now and then to 275, and Runecloth Boots (Darnall, Moonglade) to 280, at 4 bolts a craft.
